modifications.change: Materialize license symlinks as regular files for checkout independence

Add the HTML language config and queries, copied unchanged from extensions/html/languages/html at the same revision, so fenced html and xml code highlights with the native tree-sitter-html 0.23 grammar. Zed ships HTML as an extension; Quire registers it natively.
Use QuireNative for native development data/config/cache directories, isolated from Zed and Electron Quire.

Resolve each font fallback family in the fonts the app added (add_fonts) before the system fonts, and map it to the collection it came from, so a bundled fallback such as Noto Naskh Arabic takes Arabic-script text on Windows as it does on macOS and Linux. Upstream looked fallbacks up in the system collection only, which skipped app-added families.

Expose retain_sections and constrain_contexts so embedded hosts can select editor/Vim contexts and exclude nested native controls without changing binding order or key equivalents; selected bindings still load strictly.
Add try_open_file for fallible, writable persistent opens without memory fallback; reject SQLite's special memory/temporary names and read-only connections.

Add editor-local weak search-bar association, targeted submission and command-prefix hooks for embedded hosts; retain workspace lookup and preserve the bar association across Vim toggles. Keep embedded visual/local marks in the Vim session when no workspace exists. Expose initialization with session register retention while leaving default initialization unchanged. Export typed page-command parsing for persistence-aware hosts. Export host_command for host-run Ex commands. Let a host editing command start recorded Insert mode or record itself for dot-repeat, without depending on host types. Let a host take the typed count for its command and end a visual mode after acting on the selection.

Resolve search, repeat motions, word search, Ex find, and substitution through the host-aware bar lookup while retaining the copied algorithms. Ex pattern validation is exposed for prompt errors; invalid substitution ranges stop before any replacement.

Expose editor-local parsing and range/pattern validation without filename completion or unrelated IDE actions. Add typed whole-page write/write-close parsing for persistence-aware hosts, retaining the editor-only rejection API and rejecting filename/range writes. Add host_command, which splits a host-run command such as `:1,3ai` into Vim-resolved rows and arguments. Preserve the original workspace command-interceptor entry point and parser.
Use Vim-session-local marks when an embedded editor has no workspace, allowing visual Ex ranges and local mark lookup. The original workspace mark storage remains unchanged.

Allow an embedded host to retain register contents and clipboard provenance when Vim is disabled. The original initializer still resets all state; transient operators and recording state reset in both paths.
Override the workspace dependency to 0.39.1 with bundled SQLite 3.54.1, including the WAL-reset fix. The vendoring generator preserves this Quire override.

Add an exact-range single-page excerpt constructor sharing its source history while retaining non-singleton display mapping. Preserve this association on clone/grouping. Add an optional per-view edit rewrite hook before source mapping; mutable slices retain edit counts for autoindent metadata. Default constructors retain their original behavior. Add scoped opt-in view edit intent with restoration on drop and independent default intent on clone. A Structural intent marks exact source edits from host outline commands, which view filters leave unchanged.
Resolve transaction, undo, redo, grouping, and transaction removal through the optional shared source history for page excerpts, preserving the existing singleton and multi-page behavior.

Reject insertion of a different source buffer into a single-page shared-history excerpt before changing its excerpt map. Disable generic context expansion for these page embeds; their host owns the semantic range.
Hold the cursor steady while App::reduce_motion is set, as the editor already does for cursor glides, so the system Reduce motion setting stops the blink. Covered by quire's motion test.

Skip empty fold chunks when seeking tab stops, avoiding a zero-length subtraction overflow with empty replacement text. Add a focused UTF-8/tab regression with empty fold placeholders. Pass a fold placeholder with empty text and a renderer through as its own chunk, so its element still renders.

Wrap a rendered chunk, such as a fold placeholder, as one unbreakable element even before layout measures it, estimating its width from its text. Upstream split an unmeasured multi-character placeholder (LSP collapsed text, Write's code-block toolbar) at a soft wrap, and mapping that wrap row's start back to the fold map panicked in FoldPoint::to_offset. Add a focused regression with a long placeholder in a narrow wrap. Past the last transform, still yield a trailing fold placeholder with empty text and a renderer, so a page whose last line is only such a fold (Write's empty list item at the end of the page) draws it; upstream returned before asking the tab chunks. Covered by quire's empty_last_block_draws_its_bullet_on_its_own_line.
Remove two stale wrong_self_convention lint expectations that fail the all-targets editor Clippy gate on the pinned Rust toolchain. Test helper behavior and lint enforcement are unchanged.

Use unexpanded source selections for opted-in DeleteLines intent and complete selections of filtered views. Share complete-selection detection with clipboard paste and typed/replacement input, retaining canonical boundaries across hidden syntax and the existing linked edit/history pipeline. Ordinary views retain their original selection resolution.

For views with an edit filter, derive linewise deletion and register ranges from complete source lines, including hidden syntax, and scope DeleteLines intent around the normal deletion pipeline. Ordinary views retain their original behavior.
Use complete source line selections and scoped DeleteLines intent for filtered visual-line deletion; preserve ordinary and visual-block behavior.

For views with an edit filter, copy linewise motion yanks (yy, yj) from complete source lines, including hidden syntax, through the shared linewise source range used by deletion. Ordinary views and other yanks are unchanged.

For views with an edit filter, put linewise text (p, P) at the cursor line's source start or end, beyond hidden syntax, under scoped Structural intent so the filter keeps the exact source position. Ordinary views, charwise and visual puts are unchanged.

Replay recorded insertions into the focused Vim session's editor when the window has no workspace, so dot-repeat in embedded editors retypes the text after o or O. Workspace windows keep using the active item.
Scope Change intent around motion/object deletion so filtered hosts can preserve hidden block prefixes and identities. Views without a filter are unchanged.
Scope Change intent around substitute edits so filtered hosts can preserve hidden block prefixes and identities.
Verify nested edit-intent restoration and independent default intent on clone through real filtered edits.
Expose the owned syntax tree in layer-relative coordinates for independent derived analysis without mutating the shared syntax snapshot.

Retain a filtered view's complete source selection during clipboard copy and paste rather than clipping its hidden prefix through a display round trip. Reuse the input helper and original clipboard/autoindent/history paths; partial selections and ordinary views retain their existing resolution.
Emit EditorEvent::FoldsChanged from folds_did_change. Fold behavior is unchanged.

When chunks start exactly at a fold whose placeholder text is empty, include that fold so its rendered placeholder shows on the first visible line too. Chunks ending at the buffer's end also yield such a fold when it is the last transform, so a fold that is the whole last line renders. Other folds and offsets are unchanged. Covered by quire's empty_last_block_draws_its_bullet_on_its_own_line.
Keep a highlighted chunk with empty text and an element renderer instead of dropping it while splitting invisibles, so empty-text fold placeholders render their element.

An element that replaces no text (len_utf8 == 0) before a line's first character starts a hanging prefix: its width and the elements and spaces after it, rounded to space widths, indent soft-wrapped rows, so a list item's rows hang under its text instead of its drawn bullet or checkbox. Lines without such an element wrap as before; covered by test_hanging_prefix_indents_continuation_rows.

Let editor addons supply source-anchored interaction regions for the visible viewport, retaining native text layout and selection. Expose clipped fragment geometry to their renderers. Emit FoldsChanged when folds are added or removed, so hosts can follow fold state from any fold command. Let an addon draw its own indent guides (Addon::indent_guides returning HostIndentGuide rows, indentation column, pixel offset, start inset, width, colour, and a test debug selector) in place of the editor's, so Write draws rt's child guides under each parent bullet. Add a per-editor show_fold_toggles override of the gutter.folds setting (carried into EditorSnapshot and the gutter width), and a current_line_highlight getter for the per-editor override, so Write turns off gutter fold arrows over its own presentation folds and the current-line band. Covered by quire's write_draws_no_gutter_fold_arrows_or_current_line_band.
Add Editor::set_show_fold_toggles, overriding gutter.folds for one editor or following it again with None. Covered by quire's write_draws_no_gutter_fold_arrows_or_current_line_band.

Lay out addon text regions over native shaped and wrapped source fragments, excluding folded text and clipping to the viewport. Reuse the navigation overlay lifecycle and element namespace; test resize, clipping, stateful elements, removal, and unchanged source text. When an addon supplies indent guides, skip the editor's own and lay each host guide out as a plain element at content origin + the column's space width + its offset, spanning its rows' display rows from the inset below the first row's middle; guides whose rows fold into one display row are not drawn. Covered by quire's child_guides_hang_under_each_parent_bullet_through_its_subtree. Lay out gutter crease toggles from the editor's show_fold_toggles override when set, else gutter.folds, and drop prepaint's assertion on the setting alone.
Make disable_word_completions public (it was test-only) so a host completion provider for page and block references does not fall back to buffer words when no page or block matches.

Keep a non-replacing block whose row start is folded when that fold starts at the row start and ends within the row (a hidden list marker), so Write can show editable embeds below marker-folded lines. Blocks inside folds reaching across rows stay hidden as upstream. Covered by quire's embed tests; the editor crate's own tests need settings assets that are not vendored.
Add opt-in cancellable quit-request subscriptions before programmatic/native termination, with all-guard evaluation and reentrancy protection; preserve the final shutdown handler lifecycle.
Expose an optional native pre-termination callback, separate from final on_quit, without requiring changes to platforms that only support guarded programmatic quits.

When a font's family is missing, try that font's own fallbacks as the family (each keeping the fallbacks after it, and the weight, style, and features) before the global fallback stack, so a configured fallback cascade, such as Quire's bundled Arabic font after the editor font, survives a missing editor font. Upstream dropped the requested fallbacks there. Covered by quire's script_fonts test.

Register each embedded font with Core Text for the process (CTFontManagerRegisterGraphicsFont) when it is added, because font fallback cascades resolve families through Core Text and never saw fonts held only in font-kit's memory source. Quire's bundled Noto Naskh Arabic is such a fallback; without this, Arabic fell to the system's Geeza Pro. Covered by quire's script_fonts test, which fails without it.
Retain the native quit-request callback and count accepted programmatic platform quits without terminating the headless test runner.
Expose native pre-termination simulation and accepted platform-quit counts for host-level durability/close tests. Test teardown still forces shutdown to release resources.
Route applicationShouldTerminate through the optional cancellable request callback before applicationWillTerminate. Preserve the original final shutdown callback and default immediate termination.

Add QuireSettingsContent (format_tags, capture_target, spellcheck, and the ai section with QuireAiSettingsContent and AiBackendName for NR28 AI transforms, and AiWritesName for the NR29 notebook write tools' Off/Review/Apply setting) so Quire application preferences are typed settings in the same settings.json, layered and live-reloaded by SettingsStore like Zed settings.
Declare the quire module and add the optional quire section to SettingsContent.
Leave the new quire section unset when importing VS Code settings.

Add HighlightStyle::font_family (Option<&'static str>, keeping the style Copy): TextStyle::highlight replaces the run's family and keeps its fallbacks, highlight() lets the later style win, and Hash covers it. Quire sets Urdu lines' Arabic-script runs in Noto Nastaliq Urdu with it, as rt sets lang=ur lines in Quire Urdu; upstream highlights could not change a run's font. Covered by quire's write_style tests.

Add HeadlessAppContext::simulate_window_resize and simulate_window_appearance, forwarding to the TestWindow as TestAppContext does, so Quire's --capture-shell tool can render a notebook window at a chosen size and light or dark appearance without showing it. Existing methods are unchanged.
